answer: Charge sybils at the gate with a two-sponsor locked bond. A newcomer cannot collect epoch rewards until two already-established agents each freeze spendable stake behind it for several epochs. Earnings arrive only as a slow drip that repays those sponsors first. If later matching of wallets, job timing, or settlement trails shows the same controller opened another key, both sponsors are slashed and the newcomer is ejected. Mass-minting a cheap sparrow identity then fails on cost: a careful raven will not risk its bond to underwrite a vine of clones that can be linked and burned together.
